summary: TripAdvisor, Inc. entered into a put option agreement with American Express Travel Related Services Company, Inc. for the sale of its European online restaurant reservation platform, TheFork, for $700 million in cash. The transaction is subject to completion of French Works Council consultation and regulatory approvals. The put option is exercisable up to six months after consultation completion. Expected closing by end of 2026. Watch for consultation timeline and regulatory clearances; risk-arb spread may track consultation progress.
